test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 18 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question: If tan (x + y) tan (x - y) = 1, then find the value of tanx.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If tan A × tan B = 1, then A + B = 90°.

Given: tan (x + y) × tan (x − y) = 1

⇒ (x + y) + (x − y) = 90°

⇒ 2x = 90° ⇒ x = 45°

⇒ tan x = tan 45° = 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

tan (x + y) tan (x − y) = 1

**Formula Used:**

tan (A + B) = (tan A + tan B) ÷ (1 − tan A tan B)

tan (A − B) = (tan A − tan B) ÷ (1 + tan A tan B)

**Calculations:**

⇒ [(tan x + tan y) ÷ (1 − tan x tan y)] × [(tan x − tan y) ÷ (1 + tan x tan y)] = 1

⇒ (tan²x − tan²y) ÷ (1 − tan²x tan²y) = 1

⇒ tan²x − tan²y = 1 − tan²x tan²y

⇒ tan²x + tan²x tan²y = 1 + tan²y

⇒ tan²x (1 + tan²y) = 1 + tan²y

⇒ tan²x = 1

⇒ tan x = 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Complementary Angle Properties

If A + B = 90°, then sin A = cos B, tan A = cot B, and sec A = cosec B.

Important Trigonometric Rules

If tan A × tan B = 1, then A + B = 90°. Similarly, if sin A × sec B = 1, then A + B = 90°.

Double Angle Formulas

tan 2A = (2 tan A) ÷ (1 − tan²A)
